svg.title: ClinicalTrials Knowledge Graph — Full System Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end workflow from user query through LLM entity extraction, KG confirmation, analysis selection, Neo4j Cypher execution, GraphRAG context assembly, Ollama LLM answer generation, and rendered output in Streamlit.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the user input stage of the CTKG pipeline')
sendPrompt('Explain the NCT ID short-circuit in the CTKG pipeline')
sendPrompt('How does the NCT detail Cypher query work?')
sendPrompt('Explain how llm_extract_entity works in the CTKG pipeline')
sendPrompt('How does _kg_confirm work in the CTKG pipeline?')
sendPrompt('Explain conversation context carryover in the CTKG pipeline')
g.text: No new entity? Inherit from conv_context

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does llm_select_analyses work in the CTKG pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How does run_analyses execute Cypher queries in the CTKG pipeline?')
g.text: Returns (fig, df) per analysis — no disk writes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does build_graphrag_context work in the CTKG pipeline?')
sendPrompt('Explain the Analysis Agent panel in the CTKG Streamlit app')
sendPrompt('How does the Ollama LLM generate the final answer in the CTKG pipeline?')
g.text: System: entity context + KG evidence + data summary
Streaming, no token limit, grounded in KG only
Full conversation history passed each turn

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Describe the Streamlit output layer of the CTKG pipeline')
g.text: Chat panel — streamed answer + Query Details expander
Analysis panel — charts per turn, oldest-first, persistent
conv_context updated → ready for next turn
